cited.quote: conversion of over head line (OH) to underground cable (UG) have been taken up in the Chennai city

rationale: C2 (policy note) reports overhead-to-underground conversion works being taken up in Chennai and extended areas only, with no dated GO or new official step by this government for phased underground cabling across all cities. C1, C3-C5 concern other networks or urban schemes. Not started.

cited.quote: this Government will implement a wage employment scheme, on a pilot basis, to provide gainful employment to urban poor

rationale: C4 is a GO issuing guidelines for a pilot urban wage employment scheme for the urban poor, a related but different scheme, not a massive scheme for 10 lakh jobs a year for youth. C1, C2, C3, C5 concern unrelated schemes. No official step for the commitment.

cited.quote: the State Government has proposed to come up with a Sustainable Mining Policy for the State

rationale: C3 (policy note) only proposes a Sustainable Mining Policy; C1 and C2 describe industrial strategy plans and existing activity. No extract shows a formulated diversified industrial growth policy based on natural resources. C4-C5 concern climate missions.

cited.quote: While referring eligible in-patients for community-based home delivery for Palliative / Physiotherapy services

rationale: C2 mentions physiotherapists and home-based physiotherapy under the Makkalai Thedi Maruthuvam scheme, which is related but not the establishment of physiotherapy centres in every ward-level hospital. C1, C3-C5 concern COVID protocols and employee insurance. No official step for the commitment.
No extract concerns high level bridges with sluice gates in the Kollidam area. C1-C2 are other highway works, C3 a dam gate in Palghat, C4 hydro dams, C5 check dam guidelines.

C1-C2 concern a PG management-quota prospectus for self-financing colleges; C3-C5 concern 7.5% preferential seats in engineering etc. None is about urging the Union government to allocate all seats of state-run medical colleges to the state pool.
No extract concerns inter-caste marriage assistance. C1, C2, C4, C5 are agriculture and livelihood fund sanctions; C3 is the budget on SC/ST welfare without any marriage assistance.

cited.quote: These artefacts will be displayed in a world class site museum, established at Keezhadi

rationale: C1 is a budget speech statement of intent about a site museum at Keezhadi; no GO or launch is shown for museums at Keezhadi, Adichanallur or Korkai. C2-C5 concern geo-parks, an agriculture museum, tourism and housing.
No extract concerns a Games Village in Chennai. C1-C2 cover Silambam in the sports quota, C3 school sports, C4-C5 general sports statements.

cited.quote: Police Note No. SC/20/2021: Transfers and Postings of IPS and non IPS officers
The following promotions, transfers and postings are ordered with immediate effect

rationale: C4 (2021-05-14), C1, C3, C2/C5 are official orders transferring and reposting IPS officers after the government took office, a realignment of police leadership. No extract shows realignment of IAS officers, so only the IPS part is evidenced.

cited.quote: school uniforms for children from classes 1 to 8 will be implemented with supplies from powerlooms and weaving units

rationale: C4 is a budget speech statement that uniforms will be supplied from powerlooms and weaving units, not an order awarding contracts exclusively to powerloom weavers. C3 describes uniform distribution; C1-C2 concern textile administration. No official step.

cited.quote: This Government will call upon the Government of India to constitute a National
Commission for the Welfare of Fishermen to look into all aspects relating to the welfare of marine and inland fishermen

rationale: C3 and C1 (Governor's address) state the government will call upon the Union to constitute the commission, a statement of intent. No formal step such as an Assembly resolution or Chief Minister's letter is shown. C2, C4, C5 are unrelated.
No extract concerns imported fireworks. C1-C4 are COVID lockdown orders, C5 business facilitation rules for spirits licences.
No extract concerns subsidies for fishermen's boat engines. C1-C2 are agricultural machinery subsidies, C3-C4 MSME subsidies, C5 a Governor's address on other subjects.
No extract concerns disbursement of an engine subsidy to boat-owning fishermen. C1-C3, C5 are agricultural subsidies; C4 lists fisheries allocations without any engine subsidy.

cited.quote: scholarship for Ph.D courses will also be restructured and the scholarship enhanced to Rupees one lakh per annum

rationale: C5 (budget speech) announces enhancement of SC/ST Ph.D scholarships and revamp of study-abroad scholarships, a statement of intent with no GO. C1 is a portal cost reimbursement, C2 an audit of past scholarships, C4 the SC/ST Commission. No official step increasing scholarships.
No extract concerns a commission for journalists' welfare or the Majithia recommendations. C1-C5 concern other commissions (education, SC/ST, minorities, planning).

cited.quote: Construction of modern Bus Stands, improvement of existing Bus stands to modern. standards

rationale: C4 lists modern bus stands only as suggestive works under KNMT for municipalities and town panchayats, not integrated bus stands in major cities. C1-C2 audit a pre-2021 bus stand; C3, C5 concern bus operations. No official step for the commitment.
No extract concerns statues of Veerapandiya Kattabomman or the Marudhu brothers. C1-C2 cover an Independence commemoration pillar, C3 the budget, C4 police transfers, C5 the SC/ST Commission.
No extract concerns the Kavalur herbal garden in Vellore. C1-C3, C5 concern horticulture and seed schemes; C4 the budget on temples and tourism.
